model: proper cubic rotations; one fixed root; radius-three exact-cover proposals; exact radius-four GCTS continuation

protocol.proposal_backend: Z3 pb2bv-sat with grouped pseudo-Boolean lookahead conflicts
protocol.cell_feedback_policy: learn every exact dead-cell obligation, but assert at most four queued cells before each retained solver check
protocol.restart_policy: persist an exact applied prefix separately from the full FIFO learned-cell queue

matched_seed_175_ablation.interpretation: With the same seed, copy bound, and 30-second check limit, staging exact cell feedback yields five clause-distinct proposals before timeout instead of one.

restart_validation.interpretation: The exact FIFO partition survives restart, but rebuilding the heavily strengthened formula remains harder than exploring a fresh staged seed.

joint_clause_and_cell_feedback_ablation.interpretation: Joint clause-and-cell staging reaches only four proposals before timeout versus five for the matched cell-only lane, so it is not promoted as the production policy. Its different feedback schedule nevertheless contributes three exact states absent from the previous nineteen-state portfolio; every one fails immediate radius-four continuation and every learned clause replays exactly. It is retained as a complementary diversity lane.

relaxed_copy_bound_seed_188.interpretation: Relaxing the proposal cap admits three genuinely denser forty-copy radius-three states, but all four fresh states still expose immediate radius-four dead cells. The larger bound increases exact proposal diversity without yet producing a radius-four continuation target.

same_process_timeout_escalation_seed_188.interpretation: Retrying an unknown timeout in the same strengthened Z3 process recovers a forty-one-copy state after 37.8 additional seconds and avoids rebuilding the formula. The following ordinary check then recovers a second forty-one-copy state. Both are new beyond the previous twenty-six-state portfolio and both still fail immediate radius-four continuation.

interpretation: Staged feedback materially improves the GCTS proposal funnel and broadens the exact radius-four rejection sample for p10-052588. The three-seed cell-only portfolio, matched joint-feedback ablation, relaxed-copy-bound probe, and same-process timeout escalation now contain twenty-eight distinct bounded proposals through forty-one copies; all fail immediately and every learned clause instance replays exactly, but neither the <=42-copy radius-three proposal space nor the unrestricted radius-three space is exhausted. This is algorithmic progress and stronger finite-corona evidence, not a non-tiling or aperiodicity certificate.
